# Backspin

Play cue sports your way, in Mixed Reality or full VR. Backspin delivers accurate tables, spin-true cue ball physics, realistic throw, and natural table roll so every shot behaves as expected.

**Real cue-sports variants**  
Play full-size snooker, American and English 8-ball, Chinese 8-ball, and American 9-ball. Each table is tuned to real dimensions and authentic pocket geometry.
